import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

def test_primary_discovered_progression():
    """
    Test Objective: Replay and verify the discovered application journey "Primary Discovered Progression".
    Preconditions: Application server is online and reachable.
    Evidence Grounding: Derived directly from empirical DOM observations and state transitions.
    """
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context()
        page = context.new_page()

        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: http://127.0.0.1:5173/
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5173/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        # Step 2: Trigger [data-test="cart-link"] [Evidence: ev-7d831971]
        page.locator('[data-test="cart-link"]').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/cart' in page.url, f'Expected /cart in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Shopping Cart (1 item)' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Shopping Cart (1 item)'
        assert page.locator('[data-test="brand-logo"]').count() > 0
        # Step 3: Trigger [data-test="brand-logo"] [Evidence: ev-a80c40d4]
        page.locator('[data-test="brand-logo"]').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert 'Quantum Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Quantum Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones'
        assert page.locator('[data-test="brand-logo"]').count() > 0
        # Step 4: Trigger [data-test="checkout-button"] [Evidence: ev-201fcfb2]
        page.locator('[data-test="checkout-button"]').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/checkout' in page.url, f'Expected /checkout in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Checkout & Order Review' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Checkout & Order Review'
        assert page.locator('[data-test="brand-logo"]').count() > 0
        # Step 5: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:5173/login [Evidence: ev-b49d50f4]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5173/login', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/login' in page.url, f'Expected /login in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Sign In to ShopSphere' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Sign In to ShopSphere'
        assert page.locator('[data-test="brand-logo"]').count() > 0

        # Verify final application state and DOM integrity
        assert page.url is not None and page.url.startswith('http')
        assert len(page.locator('body').inner_text().strip()) > 0
        browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_primary_discovered_progression()
    print('Journey replay completed successfully.')
